name: Input
description: A text field with a label, help text, validation, icons and text addons.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon. Defaults to the browser's validation message.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon inside the field before the text, sized to 16 pixels and muted.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Icon inside the field after the text.

props.name: action
props.description: One interactive control at the end of the field, such as a show-password toggle. Pass an unstyled react-aria Button or ToggleButton (or a plain button) with an aria-label; the field sizes it to fit, gives it a hover wash and the focus ring.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the input, inside the outline and set off by a hairline.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia border and the error message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: The value can be selected and copied but not changed. Shown on a muted fill.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TextField (value, onChange, type, name, validate...).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Accepts every prop of the react-aria-components Input and of a native input.
